testSuite: Isolated Backend Contract & Failure Mode Tests

results.name: Valid inference result with action=MONITOR
results.behavior: Backend correctly assigned MONITOR and MONITORING when score >= 0.70.

results.name: Valid inference result with action=BLOCK
results.behavior: Action is BLOCK; when autoBlockEnabled=false, threat status is held at MONITORING.

results.name: Model unavailable degraded fallback action overwrite
results.defectAnalysis: CONFIRMED DEFECT: Backend line 58 discards Python action=MONITOR and recomputes ALLOW because score 0.50 < 0.70.

results.name: HTTP Timeout handling
results.behavior: CONFIRMED DEFECT: When AI Engine times out, runFullPipeline silently returns null. No alert, no log, traffic passes fail-open.

results.name: Null inference response
results.behavior: Null inference response returns null from runFullPipeline without creating database records.

results.name: Missing or malformed score fallback
results.behavior: Missing score falls back to 0.0, silently granting action=ALLOW.

results.name: DEGRADED status demotion in threatService.js
results.behavior: CONFIRMED DEFECT: threatService.js line 101 demotes score 0.50 to DETECTED, hiding DEGRADED indicator from operator.

results.name: ThreatLog Schema Rejection on status=DEGRADED
results.errorMessage: ValidationError: `DEGRADED` is not a valid enum value for path `status`.
results.behavior: CONFIRMED DEFECT: ThreatLog.js enum rejects status=DEGRADED with ValidationError.

results.name: Audit persistence failure propagation
results.behavior: When database persistence fails, runFullPipeline rethrows error rather than continuing silently.

results.name: Verification that failure is never converted to BENIGN
results.behavior: Candidate policy ensures uninspected traffic maintains predictedClass=UNINSPECTED_TRAFFIC and threatScore=0.50.
